_about: Every picture the wiki shows. dest is under wiki/ (img/<folder>/<page>.webp, the folder of the page). from is relative to the source root (the checkout that holds hotel_build/ and unity_logs/, git-ignored). card entries are drawn from catalogue data and say so in their footer.

card.title: Area door
lines: Each area of a floor is opened with F in front of its door, for points: 500 for the first, then 250 more per step away from the start, up to 1,500.
A purchase applies to everyone and for the rest of the floor. Two doors between the same areas open together.

card.title: L'Organo
lines: Cost: 50 wood, 30 steel, 4 embers. Needs: Le Volte della navata.
Effect: every wave cleared heals you fully and raises the shield to 100.

card.title: Il Confessionale
lines: Cost: 25 wood, 4 blood. Needs: Le Volte della navata.
Effect: dying still gives one obolo every 20 points, not nothing.

card.title: La Forgia
lines: Cost: 50 steel, 15 wood, 6 embers. Needs: La Sacrestia.
Effect: +15% damage with every weapon.

card.title: Il Cancello del Teatro
lines: Cost: 30 steel, 30 bones, 1 relic.
Effect: opens branch II, the buried theatre, whose boss is Il Direttore.

card.title: Il Cancello del Sanatorio
lines: Cost: 45 steel, 30 wood, 3 embers, 1 darkness crystal. Needs: Il Cancello del Teatro.
Effect: opens branch III, the sanatorium, whose boss is Il Primario.

card.title: Il Cancello del Conte
lines: Cost: 60 steel, 5 blood, 1 faith crystal. Needs: Il Cancello del Sanatorio.
Effect: opens branch IV, the wardrobe, whose boss is Il Conte.

card.title: La Cappella della Pietra
lines: Cost: 40 bones, 4 hearts, 2 relics. Needs: L'Altare maggiore.
Effect: every expedition starts with Pelle di pietra, which takes a perk slot.

card.title: La Cappella delle Mani
lines: Cost: 40 wood, 4 embers, 2 darkness crystals. Needs: L'Altare maggiore.
Effect: every expedition starts with Mani svelte.

card.title: La Vetrata del Direttore
lines: Cost: 3 darkness crystals, 20 steel. Needs: Le Volte della navata.
Effect: area doors cost 25% less.

card.title: La Vetrata del Primario
lines: Cost: 3 faith crystals, 20 bones. Needs: Le Volte della navata.
Effect: +25 maximum health.

card.title: La Vetrata del Conte
lines: Cost: 3 gems, 5 blood. Needs: Le Volte della navata.
Effect: perk books cost 40% less.

card.title: La bottega della speziale
lines: Sells holy water for 30 oboli (3 in stock), a votive candle for 120 (1; it starts the Rinascita book) and the cartographer's map for 20 (1; every level of the expedition is fully mapped).
Stock refills every time you come back from the catacombs.

card.title: Il banco dell'armaiolo
lines: Sells the reliquary mine for 45 (2), the carillon for 25 (2) and the letter of credit for 60 (2; +500 points at the start of the expedition).
Stock refills every time you come back from the catacombs.

card.title: Il carro dell'ossaio
lines: Buys 10 bones, wood or steel for 25, 30 or 40 oboli (3 each), and sells 10 of them for 8, 10 or 12.
Merchants never trade boss resources.

card.title: La tenda del cerusico
lines: Buys 1 ember, heart or blood for 35, 40 or 30 oboli (2 each), and sells 1 of each for 10, 12 or 9.
Merchants never trade boss resources.

card.title: Il Conte
lines: The Cardinale in crimson and black: the guardian of the wardrobe branch.
Killed in the third level of the Guardaroba; its trophy is three gems.

card.title: Holy-oil barrels
lines: Barrels that can be shot, like the chandeliers.
The blast of a reliquary mine sets off the barrels nearby.

card.title: Points (gold coins)
lines: Found in the rooms and out in the open of the desert.
Walk within 1.5 m to take them; what you took stays taken.

card.title: Medikit
lines: Restores 50 health.
Found in the rooms and out in the open of the desert.

card.title: Essence
lines: Gives 30 of the left hand's essence, which pays for spells and seals.
Found in the rooms and out in the open of the desert.

card.title: The wave cycle
lines: The first wave starts 8 s after arrival, the others 10 s after the previous one ends.
Three waves cleared open the exit lift; every eighth wave opens with the Cardinale.

card.title: Testa
lines: Goal: headshot kills, 6 + wave/2 (at most 14).
Completing it pays 400 + 60 per wave points and drops a power-up.

card.title: Coltello
lines: Goal: knife kills, takedowns included: 3 + wave/4 (at most 6), from wave 3.
Completing it pays 400 + 60 per wave points and drops a power-up.

card.title: Esplosivi
lines: Goal: kills by flasks, carillons, burst Appestati or door traps: 4 + wave/3 (at most 10).
Completing it pays 400 + 60 per wave points and drops a power-up.

card.title: Intatto
lines: Goal: 40 seconds in a row without taking damage.
Completing it pays 400 + 60 per wave points and drops a power-up.

card.title: Furia
lines: Goal: 8 + wave/3 kills within 15 seconds (at most 14).
Completing it pays 400 + 60 per wave points and drops a power-up.

card.title: Pelle di pietra
lines: Stone skin: +50% health.
Bought at the Biblioteca for 2,000 to 4,000 points, depending on the perks already owned.

card.title: Mani svelte
lines: Quick hands: reload 40% faster.
Bought at the Biblioteca for 2,000 to 4,000 points, depending on the perks already owned.

card.title: Doppio colpo
lines: Double tap: fire rate +33%.
Bought at the Biblioteca for 2,000 to 4,000 points, depending on the perks already owned.

card.title: Rinascita
lines: Rebirth: one rebirth per floor, on the spot, with three seconds of respite.
Bought at the Biblioteca for 2,000 to 4,000 points, depending on the perks already owned.

card.title: Passi di cenere
lines: Ash steps: footsteps are heard 40% less.
Bought at the Biblioteca for 2,000 to 4,000 points, depending on the perks already owned.

card.title: Velo
lines: Veil: seen 30% less. H makes you invisible for 5 s, then a 40 s cooldown.
Bought at the Biblioteca for 2,000 to 4,000 points, depending on the perks already owned.

card.title: Occhio della Torre
lines: Eye of the tower: the ping shows enemies through walls; headshots deal x1.25.
Bought at the Biblioteca for 2,000 to 4,000 points, depending on the perks already owned.

card.title: Sete di sangue
lines: Blood thirst: knife kills heal 25 health, takedowns 40.
Bought at the Biblioteca for 2,000 to 4,000 points, depending on the perks already owned.

card.title: Fiamma Sacrilega
lines: Costs 30 essence, cooldown 2.5 s. A fireball: 140 damage, falling to 36% at 3.5 m, burning for 4 s.

card.title: Catena del Fulmine
lines: Costs 35 essence, cooldown 4 s. 90 damage to the target in sight, jumping to four more within 6 m at 70% each; stuns 0.6 s.

card.title: Morsa di Gelo
lines: Costs 30 essence, cooldown 5 s. A 7 m cone: 60 damage and a slow; a second hit freezes for 2.5 s.

card.title: Sigillo di Sangue
lines: Costs 25 essence, cooldown 7 s. Drains the target in sight for 1.5 s (40 per second) and heals half of it; +20 essence if it kills.

card.title: Passo d'Ombra
lines: Costs 30 essence, cooldown 6 s. Teleports up to 8 m ahead, stopping before walls.

card.title: Onda del Dodecaedro
lines: Costs 35 essence, cooldown 6 s. A 200-degree wave: 70 damage, throws enemies back and stuns 0.5 s.

card.title: Essenza Maledetta
lines: Costs 60 essence, cooldown 90 s. For 12 s spells are free with a quarter cooldown, +60% damage, 6 health per second, and enemies within 3 m burn.

card.title: Danni Critici
lines: Costs 40 essence, lasts 45 s on the weapon. One hit in four is critical (x2.5).

card.title: Sanguinamento
lines: Costs 40 essence, lasts 45 s. Bleeding: 8 per second per stack, up to three stacks.

card.title: Incendiario
lines: Costs 40 essence, lasts 45 s. Burning: 10 per second for 4 s.

card.title: Corrosivo
lines: Costs 40 essence, lasts 45 s. +30% damage taken from everything for 5 s, and 4 per second.

card.title: Elettrificato
lines: Costs 40 essence, lasts 45 s. A stun of 0.4 s and an arc to two neighbours at 40%.

card.title: Gelido
lines: Costs 40 essence, lasts 45 s. A slow; four hits freeze for 2 s.

card.title: Arma Maledetta
lines: Costs 60 essence, 90 s cooldown. For 15 s: double damage, all six effects and infinite ammunition.

card.title: Ossa (bones)
lines: Most enemies drop bones and wood: monks and Veglie; abbots and Portachiavi give steel.
Used by the Ossario (60), L'Altare maggiore (30), La Fonte battesimale (15) and La Cappella della Pietra (40).

card.title: Legno (wood)
lines: Dropped by monks and Veglie, with the bones.
Used by Le Volte della navata (40), L'Organo (50), La Sacrestia (30) and Il Campanile (30).

card.title: Acciaio (steel)
lines: Dropped by abbots and Portachiavi, and by the statues.
Used by Le Volte della navata (20), La Forgia (50), Il Tesoro (30) and Il Cancello del Conte (60).

card.title: Brace (embers)
lines: Rare: 2.5 to 15% of kills, from Veglie.
Used by L'Organo (4), La Forgia (6), Il Campanile (5) and Il Cancello del Sanatorio (3).

card.title: Cuori (hearts)
lines: Rare: from abbots and chief physicians.
Used by L'Altare maggiore (3), La Cappella della Pietra (4) and Il Tesoro (2).

card.title: Sangue (blood)
lines: Rare: from flying enemies and nurses.
Used by La Fonte battesimale (2), Il Confessionale (4) and Il Cancello del Conte (5).

card.title: Reliquie (relics)
lines: Only the Cardinale of branch I drops them; never sold or bought.
Used by Il Cancello del Teatro (1), La Cappella della Pietra (2), La Vetrata del Cardinale (3) and Il Rosone (3).

card.title: Cristalli d'oscurità
lines: Only the Direttore of branch II drops them; never sold or bought.
Used by Il Cancello del Sanatorio (1), La Cappella delle Mani (2) and La Vetrata del Direttore (3).

card.title: Cristalli di fede
lines: Only the Primario of branch III drops them; never sold or bought.
Used by Il Cancello del Conte (1) and La Vetrata del Primario (3).

card.title: Gemme (gems)
lines: Only the Conte of branch IV drops them; never sold or bought.
Used by La Vetrata del Conte (3).

card.title: Furia
lines: +20% damage for the whole descent.
One of three offered after every return; the lit candle lasts the next expedition.

card.title: Grazia
lines: +30 maximum health for the whole descent.
One of three offered after every return; the lit candle lasts the next expedition.

card.title: Raccolto
lines: Resources ×1.5 for the whole descent.
One of three offered after every return; the lit candle lasts the next expedition.

card.title: Provvidenza
lines: Power-ups drop twice as often.
One of three offered after every return; the lit candle lasts the next expedition.

card.title: Decima
lines: +25% points from kills.
One of three offered after every return; the lit candle lasts the next expedition.

card.title: Porte d'oro
lines: Doors cost 30% less.
One of three offered after every return; the lit candle lasts the next expedition.

card.title: The Custode
lines: Stocky, grey hair and a moustache, olive canvas jacket, navy trousers, red wool scarf and a tweed cap.
The first slot: the host in online co-op, and player 1 in a split screen.

card.title: The Dottoressa
lines: Slight, with a brown bob that hangs to the jaw, a cream coat, charcoal trousers and a teal scarf.
Second slot: the second seat of a split screen or the second player online.

card.title: The Reporter
lines: Fair, short dark-blond hair with a fringe swept aside, a mustard jacket, blue trousers and a grey scarf.
Third slot: the third seat of a split screen or the third player online.

card.title: The Cacciatrice
lines: Strong legs, auburn hair in a long braid under a dark cap, an oxblood jacket, olive trousers and an amber scarf.
Fourth slot: the fourth seat of a split screen or the fourth player online.

card.title: The motorbike
lines: One for each player, at the foot of the cathedral stair: F mounts it, W gas, S brake, Shift turbo, top speed 83 km/h.
Tyre tracks on the sand, a speedometer and shooting from the saddle. The bike does not run enemies over.

card.title: Floor power
lines: Every floor starts on emergency lighting; the lever of the electrical panel brings the power back.
Without power the perk books, the door traps and the altar refuse to work.

card.title: The satchel
lines: Resources dropped by enemies are pulled into the satchel when you walk close: it is the zaino, top right.
Coming back up banks it in the cathedral's store; dying leaves the remains on the first level.

card.title: Points and oboli
lines: 500 points at the start; 10 per hit that does not kill, 60 per kill, 100 per headshot, 130 per knife kill.
Unspent points climbing back alive become oboli, one per 10; the poor box turns 500 points into 33.

card.title: Downed and revive
lines: At zero health you go down and crawl at 0.85 m/s; a teammate within 1.8 m revives you by holding Use for 3 s.
Once per floor you get up yourself after 5 s of Use; otherwise you bleed out after 30 s.

card.title: Stealth
lines: Monks, abbots and eyes patrol and search; the lights dim as you go down; a knife takedown is silent.
It belongs to the candle cycle only: the wave cycle has no stealth.

card.title: Characters and saves
lines: A character is a name and one of four survivors; it keeps its experience, its cathedral and its history.
An expedition can be suspended and resumed; an old save is upgraded when the new game reads it.

card.title: Online co-op
lines: Up to four players over FishNet on UDP port 7807: the host runs the world and the guests see its enemies.
Each player keeps their own points, weapons, perks, store and cathedral.

card.title: Split screen
lines: Two to four players on one PC, in the game window or over several monitors, with no network.
Each player has their own view, HUD, body, weapons, points and controller.

card.title: Minimap and way home
lines: A 512 m window, north up, with you, your companions, the awake enemies within 90 m and your parked bike.
From 90 m out a golden arrow points at the cathedral and says how far it is.

card.title: Third-person view
lines: The camera sits 2.55 m behind the eye and 60 cm to the right, and the player's own survivor is drawn.
Choose Prospettiva in the game settings. While aiming, the camera moves in to 1.18 m behind the eye.

card.title: Controller
lines: Only XInput controllers are read: Xbox 360, One and Series. A PlayStation pad needs a wrapper (not verified).
The hints name RB instead of F while a pad is the device in use.

card.title: Menu music
lines: A waltz for music box and organ in D minor, 3/4, 96 seconds, generated by the game at start-up.
Four short tones for buttons, choices and sliders; no audio file is shipped.

card.title: Display and menu
lines: Settings in five tabs: Schermo, Immagine, Audio, Comandi and Gioco; each row is saved at once.
The frame counter is on in every mode since 0.9.1, and F3 switches it on and off.

card.title: Perks
lines: Eight perks in four slots, each a magic book in the library: the next one costs 2,000 to 4,000 points.
Dying costs half of your points and the last perk you bought.

card.title: Medals
lines: Instant feats with a gold medal, a chime and a few points: chains of kills, headshots, 25 kills untouched.
Each player counts their own; the Tab scoreboard lists them and a new run starts them again.

card.title: Knife
lines: G is the knife, MISERICORDIA: a loud close-range stab; the silent takedown from behind is candle-cycle only.
A knife kill pays 130 points and doubles the power-up chance; a takedown quadruples it.

card.title: Annexes
lines: Hidden rooms of the tower floors in the wave cycle: a tower, a crypt or a garden, each behind a gate.
The secret book room of each floor holds a witchcraft or arsenal grimoire; the desert has no annexes.

card.title: Blessings
lines: After every return the altar offers three of six blessings; the one you light lasts the next descent.
It lasts the whole descent into the catacombs; the desert has no blessings.

card.title: Studio engine
lines: tools/studio_engine.py runs the content pipeline on the standard library alone and names no game.
A second project is a Project subclass; the Prying Eyes content types live in its profile.

card.title: Check suite
lines: tools/check_suite.py fails when a reusable package, the engine or the documentation crosses its boundary.
It runs before every commit, with the Python unit tests, in about a minute and with no Unity.

card.title: Ship
lines: tools/ship.ps1 builds the working tree, runs the gate, commits the exact paths and refreshes the game build.
It never blocks on a dirty tree; -RequireClean is for releases.

card.title: Release
lines: tools/release.ps1 does the mechanical part of a release: the draft, the API call and the latest flag.
A release is made only on request; the version the game shows comes from bundleVersion.

card.title: The CI gate
lines: .github/workflows/gate.yml runs the gate and the .NET rule labs on every push to preview and on every pull request.
It reports rather than blocks: there is no branch protection on preview.

card.title: Rule labs
lines: Headless labs under tools/ compile the package code from its own file path and check its rules.
The four labs of the CI gate: weapon-state, survival, economy and saves.

card.title: Blender models
lines: Blender 4.5 scripts in modelli/ build the meshes, rigs, textures and grimoire plates that Unity imports.
There are folders for the monk, the abbot, the flying eye, the Medusa, the survivors, the hotel and the grimoires.

card.title: Wiki generator
lines: tools/wiki_site.py turns the Markdown of wiki/ into the catalogue, the concept map, the graph and the static site.
tools/wiki_images.py draws the cards and the crops from the manifest in tools/wiki_images.json.

card.title: Production economy
lines: Engine-independent rules for resources: balances, constructions with prerequisites, a market and loot tables.
The extraction rules of a trip away from a safe place are in the same package.

card.title: Production layout
lines: A deterministic district planner with no Unity, Hotel, HUD or GameManager references.
The same source is compiled by PlanLab and used by the LayoutDemo project.

card.title: Production saves
lines: Save files that change shape between versions: a JSON tree, a version and a chain of migrations.
The folder store writes atomically and never destroys what a player made.

card.title: Production survival
lines: Engine-independent wave scheduling: the unspent spawn budget, the pacing and a concurrent population limit.
The caller owns the enemies, the spawn points, the difficulty and the rewards.

card.title: Production weapons
lines: WeaponState owns ammunition, reload transitions and the cadence of a weapon, with no engine dependency.
The runtime assembly has noEngineReferences set, as the other packages do.

card.title: Prying Eyes (Unity)
lines: The Unity project in unity/PryingEyes: the game, its packages and the tools that build it.
The game pages of docs/game describe what it does; this wiki describes the parts.

card.title: Earlier versions
lines: The Three.js prototype, the Unreal Engine 5 prototype and the first Unity hall, kept for reference.
None of them is the main game, which is the Unity project.

card.title: The Zombies redesign
lines: The request of 13 November 2026: remove the candles and the stealth, open the areas with points, speed the enemies up.
The wave cycle became the default; the candle cycle stayed behind a flag.

card.title: Quality audit
lines: The review of the full version, from 12 to 15 November 2026: the evidence and the open work.
It records what was checked and does not declare the review finished.

card.title: Unreal prototype
lines: The same generated room rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5.8 and photographed beside the Unity one.
A feasibility test with no Blueprints; Unity stays the game.

card.title: City prototype
lines: The Quartiere della Stazione, a scene generated from the recipe in its City folder.
A playable base checked by citylab; the Tower is not replaced.

card.title: The trailer
lines: A trailer of about 64 seconds, filmed inside the game by a recorder and cut by a Python script.
The shot list, the job and the edit are data, so the trailer can be made again.
